title: Physics Mapping Layer — Map Each Param to PRISM Engine ~8,163 Mappings
description: Create the physics mapping layer that connects every parameter in the ~8,163 parameter catalog to the PRISM engine that computes its optimal value. This is the intelligence layer: for each parameter, define which engine(s) compute the recommended value, what inputs they need (material, tool, machine, geometry), and how the computed value maps back to the parameter range. Covers force-based mappings (Kienzle), speed/feed mappings (SpeedFeedOrchestrator), stability mappings (SLD), deflection mappings, thermal mappings, surface quality mappings, and safety limit mappings.

reference: src/engines/ (all physics engines for mapping targets)

forge_triple.hook: physicsMappingCoverageValidator — BUILT — flags parameters without physics mapping
forge_triple.action: generate_physics_mappings — BUILT — generates physics mapping layer for all parameters
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-physics-map — BUILT — shows which engine optimizes each parameter

sessions.title: Force + Speed/Feed + Stability Physics Mappings (~3,000 mappings)
knowledge: KienzleForceModelEngine — kc1.1, mc per ISO group, rake/wear/speed corrections
SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine — 8 resolvers, 2,851 lines, Monte Carlo UQ
ChatterStabilityLobeEngine — SLD generation, critical depth of cut
All cutting data parameters from KC-3 and KC-4 that map to these engines
sessions.intent: Create physics mappings for cutting data parameters (spindle speed, feed rate, depth of cut, stepover, stepdown) to KienzleForceModel, SpeedFeedOrchestrator, and ChatterStabilityLobe engines. Each mapping defines: source_parameter → target_engine → computation_method → output_mapping → confidence_level.

units.title: Cutting Data → KienzleForceModel Mappings — ~1,200 mappings
units.description: Map all cutting data parameters (spindle_speed, feed_rate, feed_per_tooth, depth_of_cut, stepover, stepdown across all cycle types) to KienzleForceModelEngine computations. Each mapping specifies: (1) which Kienzle inputs to derive from the parameter (ap, ae, fz, vc), (2) material-specific kc1.1/mc from constants.ts, (3) correction factors (rake, wear, speed, size effect), (4) output force/power that constrains the parameter, (5) confidence interval from Monte Carlo UQ.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: >= 1,100 parameter-to-Kienzle mappings covering all cycle type cutting data
Each mapping references canonical kc1.1/mc from src/physics/constants.ts
Force output constrains parameter range (max_force → max allowed ap/ae/fz)
Power output constrains spindle speed (P_spindle >= P_cutting)
Unit tests validate force computation for 3 material groups (P-steel, M-stainless, K-cast iron)

units.title: Speed/Feed → SpeedFeedOrchestrator + SLD Mappings — ~1,800 mappings
units.description: Map all speed/feed-related parameters to SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine (8 resolvers) and ChatterStabilityLobeEngine. SpeedFeedOrchestrator mappings connect: material + tool + operation → recommended vc/fz/ap/ae with Monte Carlo confidence bands. SLD mappings connect: spindle_speed + depth_of_cut → stability lobe diagram check, with stable/unstable zone classification. Covers drilling, 2D, 3D, 5-axis, and turning domains.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: >= 1,200 parameter-to-SpeedFeedOrchestrator mappings
>= 500 parameter-to-SLD stability mappings
Each S/F mapping specifies which of 8 resolvers handles the computation
SLD mappings classify parameter combinations as stable/marginal/unstable
Unit tests validate S/F recommendation for endmill in P-steel and ball-nose in S-titanium

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 2,800 force + S/F + SLD mappings | ✓ canonical constants used | ✓ Monte Carlo UQ | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Deflection + Thermal + Surface Quality Physics Mappings (~2,500 mappings)
knowledge: SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine — Ra/Rz from feed, nose radius, vibration
sessions.intent: Create physics mappings for deflection-sensitive parameters (stepdown, tool overhang, wall thickness), thermal parameters (speed, feed in hardened materials), and surface quality parameters (feed, stepover, scallop height). These mappings constrain parameter values based on physical limits.

units.title: Deflection + Thermal Physics Mappings — ~1,500 mappings
units.description: Map deflection-sensitive parameters (stepdown, stepover, tool overhang, thin wall operations) to ToolDeflectionEngine and PartDeflectionEngine. Map thermal-sensitive parameters (cutting speed in hardened steel, feed in titanium, engagement in nickel alloys) to ThermalWearCouplingEngine and CuttingTemperatureEngine. Deflection mappings: parameter → force → deflection → deflection_limit_check. Thermal mappings: parameter → temperature → thermal_limit_check (white layer, tool coating failure).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: >= 800 deflection-sensitive parameter mappings with force → deflection chain
>= 600 thermal-sensitive parameter mappings with temperature prediction
Deflection limit check uses 0.050mm default tolerance (adjustable per finish requirement)
Thermal limit check uses white layer threshold from SurfaceIntegrityEngine
Unit tests for thin-wall deflection mapping and Ti-6Al-4V thermal mapping

units.title: Surface Quality + Safety Limit Physics Mappings — ~1,000 mappings
units.description: Map surface quality parameters (feed_per_rev, stepover, scallop_height, nose_radius) to SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine (Ra = f²/(32R) for turning, scallop_h = R - sqrt(R² - (ae/2)²) for milling). Map safety limit parameters (all hook-validated parameters) to the specific engine that determines the safe boundary. Create a unified PhysicsMappingRegistry that indexes all ~8,163 mappings by parameter ID for instant lookup.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: >= 600 surface quality parameter mappings with Ra/Rz prediction
>= 400 safety limit parameter mappings linked to specific blocking hooks
PhysicsMappingRegistry indexes all mappings by parameter ID (HM-P-XXXX)
Coverage report: >= 90% of all ~8,163 parameters have at least one physics mapping
Unit tests for Ra prediction from feed/nose-radius and scallop height from stepover/radius

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 2,400 deflection + thermal + surface mappings | ✓ PhysicsMappingRegistry built | ✓ >= 90% coverage | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: CAD + Fixture + Linking + Settings Physics Mappings (~1,500 mappings)
knowledge: CAD parameter physics: draft angle → DFM, wall thickness → deflection, tolerance → manufacturing cost
Fixture parameter physics: clamp force → Kienzle, stock allowance → material cost, WCS → probe accuracy
Linking parameter physics: approach speed → tool entry force, retract → cycle time
Settings parameter physics: tolerance → computation time, mesh density → simulation accuracy
sessions.intent: Create physics mappings for the remaining non-CAM domains (CAD, fixture, linking, settings). Many of these are indirect mappings (parameter → downstream effect on manufacturing) rather than direct computation. DFM mappings, cost impact mappings, and cycle time impact mappings.

units.title: CAD + Fixture + Linking + Settings Mappings — ~1,500 mappings
units.description: Create physics/DFM/cost mappings for non-CAM domains: CAD parameters (draft_angle → moldability DFM check, wall_thickness → deflection limit, fillet_radius → tooling feasibility, tolerance → manufacturing cost curve — ~275 mappings), fixture parameters (clamp_force → Kienzle-computed cutting force comparison, stock_allowance → material cost, clearance_plane → retract time — ~200 mappings), linking parameters (approach_speed → tool entry impact force, stay_down → cycle time reduction, lead_in_radius → surface quality at entry — ~960 mappings), settings parameters (tolerance → computation time estimate, mesh_density → simulation accuracy — ~265 mappings). Many are advisory (cost/time impact) rather than blocking.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: CAD physics mappings: >= 250 with DFM feasibility checks
Fixture physics mappings: >= 190 with clamp force validation
Linking physics mappings: >= 900 with cycle time impact estimation
Settings physics mappings: >= 250 with computation time estimates
Total PhysicsMappingRegistry reaches >= 7,500 mappings (>= 90% of ~8,163)
Coverage report shows unmapped parameters with justification

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 7,500 total physics mappings | ✓ >= 90% parameter coverage | ✓ DFM + cost + cycle time mappings | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Physics Mapping Validation + Coverage Gap Closure
sessions.intent: Validate all physics mappings for correctness, close coverage gaps for unmapped parameters, verify that physics computations produce values within parameter ranges, and generate the final physics mapping coverage report.

units.title: Physics Mapping Validation + Gap Closure — ~8,163 mappings verified
units.description: Validate all physics mappings: (1) verify each mapping's engine reference resolves to an existing engine, (2) verify computation outputs fall within parameter ranges, (3) identify remaining unmapped parameters and either create mappings or document as intentionally unmapped (display-only, cosmetic settings), (4) generate final coverage report with domain-by-domain breakdown, (5) run integration tests that exercise the full parameter → physics → recommendation pipeline for 5 representative operations.

exit_criteria: All engine references in mappings resolve to existing engines (zero dangling refs)
Physics computation outputs verified within parameter ranges for 100 sample parameters
Coverage >= 95% of ~8,163 parameters (remaining ~5% documented as display-only/cosmetic)
Integration test: full pipeline for endmill pocket in P-steel produces valid S/F/ap/ae recommendations
Integration test: full pipeline for ball-nose 3D finish in S-titanium produces valid scallop/feed

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 95% physics mapping coverage | ✓ zero dangling engine refs | ✓ 5 integration tests pass | omega_floor >= 0.90
